project: Production-Grade Real-Time Graph Fraud Detection Platform

epics.name: Multi-Entity Simulator & Adversarial Attack Generator
epics.description: High-throughput simulation of Users, Cards, Devices, IPs, Merchants, Addresses, with realistic fraud attacks (carding bursts, device sharing, impossible travel, IP proxy farms, merchant collusion, ATO).

tasks.title: Multi-Entity & Transaction Simulator
acceptance_criteria: Generates 6 distinct relational entities: User, Card, Device, IP, Merchant, Address
Simulates realistic background legitimate transactional behavior with diurnal patterns
Outputs streaming transaction records with full entity bindings and timestamps

tasks.title: Adversarial Fraud Scenario Injector
acceptance_criteria: Injects 6 distinct fraud patterns: Velocity bursts, Device-sharing rings, Impossible travel, IP proxy clusters, Merchant collusion, Account Takeover
Simulates evolving fraud behaviors and delayed label arrival (14-90 days)
Generates ground-truth fraud labels and attack metadata

epics.name: Dynamic Heterogeneous Entity Graph & Ring Detector
epics.description: Constructs and maintains a dynamic multi-relational entity graph with temporal edge decay, cycle detection, and fraud-ring clustering.

tasks.title: Dynamic Heterogeneous Entity Graph
acceptance_criteria: Maintains typed nodes (User, Card, Device, IP, Merchant, Address) and directed temporal edges
Sub-second incremental graph updates on incoming streaming transactions
Computes dynamic 1-hop and 2-hop neighborhood subgraphs for arbitrary entities

tasks.title: Graph Topology & Fraud Ring Clustering
acceptance_criteria: Detects connected components, high-degree shared devices/IPs, and circular transaction flows
Computes graph topological metrics: degree centrality, shared entity ratio, clustering coefficient
Assigns graph-based syndicate risk scores to entities

epics.name: Streaming Ingestion & Online/Offline Feature Store
epics.description: Kafka-compatible streaming ingestion, real-time windowed aggregation, and point-in-time consistent feature store.

tasks.title: Streaming Window Feature Aggregator
acceptance_criteria: Computes tumbling and sliding window metrics across 1m, 5m, 1h, 24h, 7d intervals
Calculates card velocity, user spend acceleration, device uniqueness ratio, and geo-distance velocity
Guarantees point-in-time correctness without lookahead leakage

tasks.title: Dual Online & Offline Feature Store
acceptance_criteria: Online low-latency key-value feature retrieval (< 5ms)
Offline historical feature store for reproducible model training
Strict schema validation and feature consistency checking

epics.name: Evolutionary Model Progression Hierarchy
epics.description: Full model progression from Logistic Regression and XGBoost to Isolation Forest, Autoencoder, GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, and Temporal-GNN.

tasks.title: Tabular Baselines (Logistic Regression & XGBoost)
acceptance_criteria: Interpretable L1/L2 penalized Logistic Regression baseline with calibrated probabilities
High-performance XGBoost classifier with feature importances and class-imbalance weighting
Leakage-safe temporal validation splits

tasks.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detectors (Isolation Forest & Autoencoder)
acceptance_criteria: Isolation Forest baseline for zero-day anomaly detection
PyTorch Deep Autoencoder trained on reconstruction loss of benign transactional patterns
Outputs normalized anomaly risk scores

tasks.title: Graph Neural Networks (GCN, GraphSAGE & GAT)
acceptance_criteria: 2-layer GCN aggregating local structural patterns
Inductive GraphSAGE with Mean/Pooling aggregator for unseen nodes and transactions
Multi-head Graph Attention Network (GAT) learning adaptive edge attention weights

tasks.title: Temporal Graph Neural Network (T-GNN)
acceptance_criteria: Incorporates edge timestamps and exponential time-decay kernels
Maintains dynamic historical node state embeddings
Proves whether temporal graph complexity improves fraud detection over static GNNs

epics.name: Sub-Second Scoring Engine & Cost-Sensitive Decision Policy
epics.description: Ultra-low latency inference engine, cost-sensitive threshold optimization, reason codes, and supporting graph evidence.

tasks.title: Real-Time Scoring Engine & Decision Policy
acceptance_criteria: Sub-second end-to-end inference latency (< 50ms P99)
Cost-sensitive threshold optimization minimizing C_FP + C_FN
Emits categorical decisions: APPROVE, CHALLENGE, DECLINE with risk score (0-100)

tasks.title: Explainability & Evidence Assembly
acceptance_criteria: Extracts top contributing risk factors and triggered velocity/graph rules
Assembles 2-hop graph evidence showing linked suspicious devices/IPs/cards
Outputs complete audit log with immutable decision hash

epics.name: Model Monitoring, Drift Detection & Automated Retraining
epics.description: Real-time drift detection (PSI, KS-test), delayed label feedback, and automated retraining triggers.

tasks.title: Concept & Feature Drift Monitor
acceptance_criteria: Computes Population Stability Index (PSI) and Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistics on feature distributions
Detects prediction distribution shifts and adversarial pattern mutations
Emits automated retraining alerts when drift exceeds thresholds (PSI > 0.25)

tasks.title: Delayed Labels & Retraining Pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Simulates delayed chargeback feedback arrival (14-90 days)
Ingests fraud investigator feedback into gold labeled dataset
Executes automated model retraining and champion/challenger comparison

epics.name: Comprehensive Scientific Evaluation Harness
epics.description: Scientific benchmark comparing all 8 models (LR, XGB, IF, AE, GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, T-GNN) under identical temporal splits.

tasks.title: Multi-Model Scientific Evaluation Suite
acceptance_criteria: Measures Precision, Recall, PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, Fraud Capture Rate @ 1% FPR
Computes False Positive Cost vs Fraud Prevented
Benchmarks inference latency and throughput across all 8 models

epics.name: FastAPI Web Service & Streaming APIs
epics.description: High-throughput REST and SSE endpoints for transaction scoring, live stream events, graph inspection, and analyst decisions.

tasks.title: FastAPI Streaming & Investigation Endpoints
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/score for sub-second real-time transaction scoring
GET /api/stream for SSE streaming of live transactions and risk decisions
GET /api/graph/entity/{id} and /api/benchmark endpoints
POST /api/investigation/decision for analyst feedback and actions

epics.name: Fraud Investigation Console Frontend
epics.description: React + TypeScript analyst workspace with live transaction stream, interactive graph visualizer, fraud ring inspector, and model benchmark comparisons.

tasks.title: React + TypeScript Fraud Console
acceptance_criteria: Real-time transaction stream with color-coded risk scores
Interactive 2-hop entity graph neighborhood explorer
Fraud ring syndicate detector and model explanation panel
Analyst action modal (Approve, Confirm Fraud, Whitelist)

epics.name: Packaging, Docker, Kubernetes & AWS Infrastructure
epics.description: Production Dockerfile, docker-compose, Kubernetes manifests, and enterprise AWS deployment guide.

tasks.title: Containerization & Cloud Infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: Multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml
Kubernetes deployment and HPA manifests
Comprehensive AWS production deployment guide (MSK, EKS, RDS, Redis, S3)
